intent: Add the skim layer to long reports, so a long report can be skimmed and deep-linked. Warrant WG-WEB-006 (reference-first, skim-first where a surface is read once). Source row WO-0016. Outside the consolidation programme. Acceptance: (1) the synthesize step emits a leading In brief heading of 3 to 5 bullets, rendered as a band above the prose; (2) slugged ids on the heading branch of renderReportHtml, mirrored in the HTML export; (3) an on-page navigator when a report carries four or more h2s. Done when a long report can be skimmed and deep-linked. Note carried from the row: do not lower type to fit, because the no-sub-12px-type baseline stays shrink-only. Tier proposal R1, anticipated factor size-threshold from derived signal diff-size. Closed 2026-08-23 in c5a3ff71. Deep Research reports gain a leading In brief band, slugged heading ids mirrored into the HTML export so a long report can be deep-linked, and an on-page navigator once a report carries four or more h2s. The renderer tolerates a report with no In brief section, which matters because every report already sitting in someone's database predates this change and must still render. No type was lowered to fit.
